name: dashboard-hero-16x9
description: 16:9 desktop hero shots for the README — one per profile, full-page screenshots.

notes.purpose: Public README hero gallery. Run with --local from any machine with this repo cloned.
notes.dates: capture.ps1 opens every page with ?today=asof, pinning 'today' to that profile's own asOf / last_updated, and renames hero output to <slug>-<width>.png for the README. Pass -RealDate to render with the machine's date instead.
